title: HEE Skill
description: A reusable, invokable PROCEDURE -- narrower and more operational than a BlueprintDoctrine (which is principle-level doctrine, not steps). A Skill captures something that was actually done, worked, and is worth doing the same way again. Requires kind=Skill.

trigger.description: When/why this skill applies -- the situation that should make someone reach for it.

prerequisites.description: What must already be true/available before running this skill.

procedure.description: The actual steps. 'script' for an executable procedure with a real path in this repo; 'steps' for a manual/human procedure. At least one required.

script.description: Repo-relative path to an executable implementing this skill.

verification.description: How to confirm the skill actually worked -- not just that it ran.

evidence.description: Pointer to real, disk-backed proof this skill was actually used successfully -- a commit, PR, or .hee/evidence/ path. Not a claim, a reference.
